prompts.title: SaaS Landing Page Copy
prompts.content:
Write conversion-focused copy for a SaaS landing page:

Product: [PRODUCT NAME]
Target Audience: [AUDIENCE]
Main Benefit: [BENEFIT]

Include:
- Hero headline
- Subheadline
- 3 key features
- Call to action
- Social proof section

prompts.title: Python FastAPI Boilerplate
prompts.content:
Generate a production-ready FastAPI application with:

- SQLAlchemy ORM
- JWT authentication
- CORS middleware
- Pydantic models
- Error handling
- Docker setup
- .env configuration

Include folder structure and main files.

prompts.title: YouTube Video Script
prompts.content:
Create a YouTube video script:

Topic: [TOPIC]
Duration: [DURATION]
Target Audience: [AUDIENCE]

Structure:
- Hook (first 10 seconds)
- Introduction
- Main content (3-5 key points)
- Call to action
- Outro

Tone: [TONE]

prompts.title: Ebook Outline Generator
prompts.content:
Generate a comprehensive ebook outline:

Topic: [TOPIC]
Target Reader: [READER]
Goal: [GOAL]

Create:
- Book title options (3)
- Subtitle
- Chapter structure (8-12 chapters)
- Key takeaways per chapter
- Bonus content ideas

prompts.title: Social Media Content Calendar
prompts.content:
Create a 30-day social media content calendar:

Brand: [BRAND]
Platforms: [PLATFORMS]
Niche: [NICHE]
Goals: [GOALS]

For each post include:
- Caption
- Hashtags
- Best posting time
- Content type (image/video/carousel)
- Call to action

prompts.title: Code Review Checklist
prompts.content:
Review this code and check:

✓ Code Quality:
- Clear variable names
- Proper function decomposition
- DRY principle
- SOLID principles

✓ Security:
- Input validation
- SQL injection prevention
- XSS protection
- Authentication/Authorization

✓ Performance:
- Algorithm efficiency
- Database queries
- Memory usage
- Caching opportunities

✓ Testing:
- Unit test coverage
- Edge cases
- Error handling

Provide specific recommendations.

prompts.title: Business Plan Generator
prompts.content:
Create a lean business plan:

Business Idea: [IDEA]
Industry: [INDUSTRY]
Target Market: [MARKET]

Sections:
1. Executive Summary
2. Problem Statement
3. Solution
4. Market Analysis
5. Revenue Model
6. Marketing Strategy
7. Financial Projections (Year 1)
8. Milestones (90 days)

prompts.title: React Component Generator
prompts.content:
Generate a React component with TypeScript:

Component: [NAME]
Purpose: [PURPOSE]

Requirements:
- TypeScript interfaces
- Props validation
- Custom hooks if needed
- Error boundaries
- Accessibility (ARIA)
- Unit tests (Jest)
- Storybook story

Use modern React patterns (hooks, context).
